items: Never be without a loaded rally.
67 has four alliances deep enough to rally at full strength (AEAS, CoRe, BZRA and Mori). Our answer is two groups alternating; the next rally is formed before the current one lands.
Our top heroes outrank theirs at almost every depth. That only counts if those players are inside the city, so the 30 garrison places go by hero might.

Turrets fire on the city and kill the other server's soldiers. Our NE and SE turrets are next to NEXT's corner, UKR and WPP; keep them reinforced. Every one of 67's turrets we take stops its fire on our garrison.
Both earlier losses to 67 came from them filling ranks 26–100. Anyone with a march out should be hitting something until the end.
+2% attack per flag, up to five.
A flag lasts 30 minutes and has a 71.5-hour cooldown, so everyone has one flag for this match. Five flags on one spot give +10%.
Four waves of five per alliance keep +10% running for two hours.
A flag reaches about three bases each way. WPP's stack behind R4 covers all seven wall bases and the two rows behind them. Five flags of a wave go on neighbouring tiles of the same flag row.
The reach also takes in our two turrets and the right half of the city. Place one flag early and see whether the bonus shows for troops there.

sections.text: Their front line is Toxa (102.6M, Vero), ༺e乂ception༻ (97.0M) and TURTLETURTLE (91.0M), both AEAS. AEAS (21 top-100 heroes) took our city on 10 October; CoRe (17), BZRA (16) and Mori (15) are their other full rally groups. Expect AEAS first and plan the garrison against it.

The 15 bases touching the city go by the strength each alliance brings: hero might of the players who were on the last two KvK boards. Inside each alliance, those players come first by hero might, then everyone else. A one-tile flag row runs between every row of bases.
